title: SuperTrailsPRO
description: Advanced Trails, Wings & Visual Effects | Fully Customizable | Reloaded & Optimized
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1f30098087300affc3f3fa30397fead4eccf9acd.png)

Project Revival Notice
This plugin was originally created by kvq, but the project was eventually discontinued and abandoned.

Instead of letting a great plugin disappear, SuperTrailsPro was rebuilt and brought back to life as a reloaded version, with:

Rewritten and optimized code
New features and improvements
Better performance
Continued support and updates

This project aims to preserve the original idea while improving and maintaining it for modern servers.

![about](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6df1c5c7023138eeb68bd41929f0f42a74685c68.png)

SuperTrailsPro is a complete rewrite of the original plugin, bringing it back to life with:

✅ New optimized code

✅ Better performance

✅ New features

✅ Multi-language support

✅ Continuous updates

This is not just a reupload — it's a revived and improved project.

![features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da03f160df51ad52da2dd400b9ec7ec37f031203.png)

️ Compatibility & Integrations

✔Vanish support (hide trails automatically)
✔ Invisible potion detection
✔ Combat hider (perfect for PvP servers)

✔ Smart sound system (auto version compatibility)

![commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05ecc47058d92967a76b5189599028190ae02aec.png)

/trails → Open trails GUI
/trailsid <Name/ID> [Player] → Apply trail (Admin)
/trailid custom <Data> <Player> → Apply custom trail data (Admin)
/supertrails → Main menu
/supertrails event → Event commands list
/supertrails npcmode → Apply trail to NPC

![faq](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/baf11906011a9c67806d9c2c7429aaf047b7bafd.png)

❔ Why are there no wings in the menu?
Because the plugin supports custom wings only by default.
You need to create wing presets.


❔ How to create custom wings?
Use the built-in system or follow the tutorial:

How to create wings?
/trailsid tutorial
Trails\Mode\Color IDs

❔ How to give a specific trail?

Example:
/supertrails event give <player> <id>


❔ What is a timed event?
Temporarily allow players to open event chests for free.

Example:
/supertrails event timed 300 10

Time formats:
H1 → 1 hour
M30 → 30 minutes

Configuration
The plugin includes a fully customizable config:

GUI layout
Trails behavior
Combat settings
World restrictions
Performance tweaks
MySQL support
